claim: CBAM is formally linked to EU ETS while retaining distinct CBAM rules
direct_evidence: CBAM complements the system ... established under Directive 2003/87/EC; "set to replace the mechanisms ... to prevent ... carbon leakage"
inferential_step: The text expressly defines complementarity and replacement for specified mechanisms; this establishes a legal connection but not a complete regime relation

claim: Importation of covered goods is conditioned on CBAM declarant authorization
direct_evidence: only by an authorised CBAM declarant; applicants must apply before importation
inferential_step: The authorization status is a formal gate on market entry and links applicant, competent authority and customs control

claim: Annual declaration and certificate surrender are duties of the authorized CBAM declarant
direct_evidence: shall ... submit a CBAM declaration; "shall surrender ... a number of CBAM certificates"
inferential_step: The paired duties connect emissions information to a quantified compliance obligation

claim: Third-country operator registration and emissions duties are distinct from declarant duties
direct_evidence: upon request by an operator; operator shall determine embedded emissions and ensure verification
inferential_step: The provision assigns registry and information tasks to operators while Articles 6 and 22 retain declaration/surrender duties with declarants

claim: Verifier assurance is a legally required function with designated qualifications
direct_evidence: verified by a verifier accredited pursuant to Article 18; national accreditation body may accredit a person
inferential_step: The text establishes a third-party assurance role and accreditation controls; it does not establish actual verifier independence in practice

claim: The Commission maintains a registry that carries declarant and certificate information and shares access with authorities
direct_evidence: Commission shall establish a CBAM registry; information available "automatically and in real time" to customs and competent authorities
inferential_step: Registry administration and structured information availability connect several institutional roles through an instrument

claim: Customs authorities control import eligibility and transmit import data into a Commission/national authority information chain
direct_evidence: shall not allow the importation by a non-authorized declarant; customs authorities communicate specific information to Commission
inferential_step: The legal control and data-transfer provisions create a customs-to-administration relation supporting eligibility checks

claim: Commission and competent authorities have distinct but linked review and control functions
direct_evidence: Commission carries out risk-based controls and has oversight role; competent authority may also review declarations
inferential_step: The provisions distribute review across Union and Member State levels and specify information sharing

claim: Commission technical rulemaking is bounded by statutory procedures and institutional controls
direct_evidence: Implementing acts follow examination procedure; specified delegated acts are subject to objection/revocation
inferential_step: The statute delegates detailed rulemaking while retaining procedure-specific committee and Parliament/Council controls

claim: The Regulation allocates meaningful but bounded discretion in review, authorization, and penalty decisions
direct_evidence: risk-based controls; enumerated authorization criteria; penalty amount depends in particular on listed factors
inferential_step: Specific criteria, risk-based triggers, ranges and factors establish structured choice; actual exercise and consistency remain unobserved

claim: Circumvention investigation can be initiated through state/affected/interested-party notification or Commission initiative
direct_evidence: Commission acts on relevant and objective data; specified parties may notify; Commission may itself determine investigation necessary
inferential_step: This creates multiple evidentiary initiation routes with Commission investigation authority

claim: Declarants' recordkeeping is designed to enable verification and administrative review
direct_evidence: Records must be sufficiently detailed to enable verifier verification and Commission/competent authority review
inferential_step: The stated purposes link a regulated party's information duty to verification and review functions

claim: Penalty procedure includes notice of conclusion, reasons and amount before/with imposition
direct_evidence: Competent authority shall notify person of conclusion, reasons and penalty amount
inferential_step: The procedural notice is a formal answerability/procedural safeguard; this does not establish appeal outcomes or enforcement practice

claim: Commission reporting duties create a formal reporting line to Parliament and Council
direct_evidence: Commission shall present reports to European Parliament and Council on application and review
inferential_step: The provision identifies reporting actors, recipients and subject matter; it supports a reporting relationship but not by itself full accountability

claim: The Regulation constitutes a linked formal CBAM governance architecture across public bodies, declarants, operators and verifiers
direct_evidence: Authorization gates importation; declarations require verified emissions; customs/registry data enable review; certificates are sold, surrendered and enforced
inferential_step: The cross-provision configuration distributes governing work and capacity in a connected arrangement; significance follows from gating, sequencing and consequences rather than frequency

claim: The Regulation assigns institutional functions to Member State authorities and the Commission where a specific counterpart relation is not established by that assignment alone
direct_evidence: Each Member State shall designate the competent authority; Commission shall assist and coordinate; Commission "shall have the oversight role"
inferential_step: These are actor-linked normative assignments; an assignment alone does not create a more specific dyadic relation or establish performance
